title: Prowess
description: A premium vanilla-style RPG stat sheet for item tooltips, with live equipment comparisons, icons, durability bars, and Elytra flight stats.
body:
# Prowess

Prowess is a client-side Fabric mod that transforms vanilla item tooltips into clean RPG-style stat sheets.

Hover over weapons, tools, armor, or Elytra to see useful stats in a compact vanilla-friendly layout with icons, comparison colors, and durability information.

## Features

- Live comparisons with your equipped armor or main-hand item
- Attack Damage and Attack Speed stats
- Armor, Armor Toughness, and Knockback Resistance stats
- Green upgrade and red downgrade indicators
- Durability values and color-coded durability bars
- Elytra flight estimates for Firework Rocket durations 1, 2, and 3
- Support for custom attributes added by other mods
- Simple configuration file

## Client-Side Only

Prowess only improves tooltip presentation. It does not change damage, armor, gameplay mechanics, or server logic.

The mod is not required on the server.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.1.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.2 or newer
- Fabric API 0.148.0+26.1.2
- Java 25
